${o.getMessage("This contains considerations for Lab Facilitators.")}

${o.getMessage("Lab Presentation")}

  1. ${o.getMessage("Download the Lab Presentation deck (accessible only through internal ServiceNow login credentials).")}
  2. ${o.getMessage("Familiarize yourself with the presentation guide and modify it as needed.")}
  3. ${o.getMessage("Update the Lab URL, QR Codes, and Reservation codes accordingly — using a URL shortener with QR codes keeps the experience seamless for participants.")}

${o.getMessage("Credentials for integrated systems are not shown in this lab guide — they are kept in a separate credential sheet requiring ServiceNow login.")}

${o.getMessage("Integration Hub Action Endpoint")}

  2. ${o.getMessage("Updates are ongoing to make the Integration Hub endpoint used for the Action more scalable for more attendees.")}

  1. ${o.getMessage("Go to neon.tech and sign up using GitHub or Google login.")}
  2. ${o.getMessage("Click New Project.")}
  3. ${o.getMessage("Enter a project name (e.g. wdf-loom).")}
  4. ${o.getMessage("Select a region close to your lab audience (e.g. East US 2 for Americas, Singapore for APAC).")}
  5. ${o.getMessage("Click Create Project.")}
  6. ${o.getMessage("Once created, note your Project ID from the dashboard URL (e.g. shy-base-71725149) — you will need this later.")}

  1. ${o.getMessage("In your Neon project, navigate to SQL Editor from the left sidebar.")}
  2. ${o.getMessage("Open neon_setup.sql from this repository and copy its entire contents.")}
  3. ${o.getMessage("Paste it into the Neon SQL Editor and click Run.")}
  4. ${o.getMessage("You should see output confirming 24 rows inserted, with a sample row for cost center CC_IT_001.")}

${o.getMessage("Step 3: Create a Neon API Key")}

  1. ${o.getMessage("In the Neon Console, click your profile icon (bottom-left), then Account Settings.")}
  2. ${o.getMessage("Go to API Keys, then Generate new API key.")}
  3. ${o.getMessage("Give it a name (e.g. wdf-lab-mcp) and click Create.")}
